stem:
Squares X, Y, and Z are joined at two vertices each to create the right triangle shown in the diagram.

The area of Square X is 441 square centimeters, and the area of Square Y is 400 square centimeters. Which measurement is closest to the side length of Square Z in centimeters?
visual_elements: Diagram of three squares labeled X, Y, and Z joined at vertices forming a right triangle with a right angle indicated.
